readiness.hed: A Freeze Warning covers Fredericksburg from midnight into Saturday morning, with temperatures dropping into the low 30s as a dry, sunny weekend settles in
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service has issued a Freeze Warning for Spotsylvania and Stafford Counties from midnight tonight through 8 a.m. Saturday, with sub-freezing temperatures as low as 31 expected; NWS notes this is the last frost/freeze product the office expects to issue until spring 2027 as the growing season closes. This afternoon stays mostly sunny near 53 with north wind around 8 mph, then clears further tonight with a low around 32. Saturday brings a high near 54 under mostly sunny skies before a cold but milder overnight near 34, and Sunday warms slightly to a high near 56 with a low around 32 Sunday night. Precipitation chances stay at 5 percent or below through the entire period.
actions: Protect sensitive plants, exposed pipes and outdoor spigots tonight and Saturday night as temperatures drop into the low 30s under the Freeze Warning.
Bring in or cover anything that can't handle a hard freeze — NWS says this is likely the season's last freeze advisory until spring.
Secure light outdoor items today as north wind picks up to around 8 mph.
A clear, cool weekend is a good window for outdoor work or yard cleanup once the Saturday-morning freeze lifts.
